coverageNotes: Tests partial-update API recognition, not the full CRUD system.

questions.context: Using Convex 1.44.0, locations requires name: string, latitude: number and longitude: number. Inside a mutation, id identifies an existing row and name is a new string.
questions.question: Which code updates the name while preserving the same document ID and both coordinates?

options.rationale: Replace requires a complete document. The supplied value fails static and runtime validation for missing coordinates, so no replacement commits.
Insert would create a new document, but this exact value first fails required-coordinate validation.
Patch updates only the supplied field and preserves the document ID and omitted coordinates.
The insert fails required-coordinate validation; the mutation rolls back the preceding delete. Even a complete delete/insert would create a new ID.
